papers.abstract: Autoregressive large language model (LLM) serving is increasingly limited by key-value (KV) cache movement rather than dense matrix multiplication. papers.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale large language models (LLMs) to hundreds of billions of parameters. 方法：提出了一种几何公平感知路由算法，旨在平衡不同设备之间的延迟和吞吐量，提升网络的整体性能。
相关性：该论文与边缘网络中的联邦学习和资源优化相关，创新性地关注了网络拓扑的几何结构对路由的影响。
